verses.5: But put forth thine hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse thee to thy face.
verses.8: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.
verses.9: Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse God, and die.
verses.10: But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not
verses.12: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his mantle, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.
verses.13: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.
